nodes.name: SkillMapper.java
nodes.summary: Mapper component converting Skill entities and related associations into skill-related response DTOs (item, selected, required skill responses).

nodes.name: SkillMapper
nodes.summary: Mapper converting Skill entities to various response DTOs used across skill-selection and career endpoints.

nodes.name: toSkillItemResponse
nodes.summary: Maps a single Skill entity to a SkillItemResponse, joining related career names into a comma-separated string.

nodes.name: toSkillItemResponses
nodes.summary: Maps a list of Skill entities to a list of SkillItemResponse DTOs.

nodes.name: toSelectedSkillResponses
nodes.summary: Resolves student-selected skills by id and maps them to SkillItemResponse DTOs, filtering out unresolved skills.

nodes.name: toRequiredSkillResponses
nodes.summary: Resolves required skills for a career and maps them to RequiredSkillResponse DTOs including importance level.

nodes.name: StudentDashboardMapper.java
nodes.summary: Mapper component assembling the entire student dashboard payload: roadmap progress, skill gaps, mentor feedback, AI history, market demand, and recommendations from multiple domain entities.

nodes.name: StudentDashboardMapper
nodes.summary: Central mapper producing all student-dashboard response DTOs from roadmap, skill, feedback, and chat entities.

nodes.name: toRoadmapProgressResponse
nodes.summary: Wraps a list of roadmap step responses and an AI tip into a DashboardRoadmapProgressResponse.

nodes.name: toRoadmapStepResponse
nodes.summary: Maps a SkillNode and its status into a RoadmapStepResponse.

nodes.name: toSkillGapItemResponse
nodes.summary: Builds a SkillGapItemResponse for a required skill, resolving the skill entity, gap type, description, and progress.

nodes.name: toMentorFeedbackItemResponse
nodes.summary: Maps a Feedback entity to a MentorFeedbackItemResponse with a formatted relative time and read flag.

nodes.name: toAiHistoryItemResponse
nodes.summary: Builds an AiHistoryItemResponse from a chat session and message, deriving a tag from the message role.

nodes.name: toMarketDemandResponse
nodes.summary: Builds a MarketDemandResponse from growth stats, career role name, and chart data.

nodes.name: toEmptyMarketDemandResponse
nodes.summary: Builds a placeholder MarketDemandResponse with zero growth when no market data is available.

nodes.name: toRecommendationItemResponse
nodes.summary: Builds a RecommendationItemResponse for a required skill, resolving skill name and description.

nodes.name: importanceRank
nodes.summary: Converts an importance level into a numeric rank used for sorting skill gaps.

nodes.name: skillGapType
nodes.summary: Derives the skill-gap display type (e.g. critical vs recommended) from an importance level.

nodes.name: skillDescription
nodes.summary: Builds a human-readable skill description combining category and related career names.

nodes.name: formatRelativeTime
nodes.summary: Formats a LocalDateTime into a human-readable relative time string (e.g. "5 minutes ago").

nodes.name: toProfileResponse
